component.name: Remind Me
component.summary: Create quick reminders that notify you at the right time

description.p: Remind Me is a focused reminder app for quick one-time notes. Write a sentence with an optional English schedule such as “@tomorrow 9am”, and receive an actionable desktop notification when it is due.
Reminders stay on your device. Complete or snooze them from the notification, review upcoming reminders by day, and keep a local history of completed items.
Initial release with local reminders, snoozing, and history.
